analyst.summary: HEG's graphite electrode business is recovering from a cyclical trough, with revenue and profit both growing at a healthy double-digit clip in the latest quarter. However, a significant portion of reported profit comes from investment income rather than the core electrode business, so underlying operating returns remain modest even as the headline numbers improve. At over 30 times earnings, the stock already prices in a meaningful continuation of the current upcycle, in a business whose economics can swing sharply in either direction.
